summary: There's a part of you that knows a need to be seen and to matter and a fast, restless mind are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you shine and lead without trying and you think and talk your way through anything. At the edge, you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking.
body: There's a part of you that knows a need to be seen and to matter and a fast, restless mind are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you shine and lead without trying and you think and talk your way through anything. At the edge, you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking. Strong for pitching, writing, and putting your own thinking forward in your own voice.
gift: At your best: you shine and lead without trying, and you think and talk your way through anything.
shadow: The trap: you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking — or you overthink it, or talk when you should feel.
integration: Let identity and thinking and speech cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Strong for pitching, writing, and putting your own thinking forward in your own voice.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you shine and you think work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You make it all about you
Let the reflex make the decision
